collection_name: All Telugu-language items on archive.org (language:Telugu OR tel)
description: Largest open pool of Telugu scans. 713,177 items carry a Telugu language tag, but 596,894 of them are Government Orders (andhra-goir 511,111; telangana-goir 85,783). Excluding GOs there are 107,882 Telugu texts; 108,766 items have Telugu detected by IA's OCR. Major sub-collections are catalogued as separate records (TEL-DLIB-002..., TEL-MSS-001, TEL-PERIOD-001..., TEL-GOV-001...).
genres: books; magazines; newspapers; government documents; manuscripts; audio; video
formats: PDF; JP2/JPG page images; DjVu-derived text (_djvu.txt); hOCR; EPUB; MP3; MP4
content_types: scanned books; periodicals; GOs; gazettes; audio; video
size_telugu: 713,177 items tagged Telugu; 704,776 texts; 2,905 audio; 3,721 movies; 107,882 texts excluding Government Orders
metadata_fields: identifier; title; creator; date; language; collection; licenseurl; ocr engine; imagecount
annotations: automatic OCR (Tesseract 4/5) for most text items
ocr_transcription: Tesseract OCR text (_djvu.txt, _hocr.html, _chocr) generated by IA for most Telugu items; quality varies strongly with typeface and scan quality.
acquisition_method: pip install internetarchive; ia search 'language:(Telugu OR tel) AND NOT collection:andhra-goir' --itemlist > ids.txt; ia download --itemlist ids.txt --glob='*_djvu.txt' (text only) or '*.pdf' (scans). Respect rate limits.
license: Varies per item — most items carry no licence statement; some PD Mark / CC licences
copyright_notes: Absence of a licence field does not mean public domain. Many Telugu uploads (DLI, user uploads, e-papers) are in-copyright. Apply Indian term (author's life + 60 years) and US term per item.
provenance: Uploads from Digital Library of India, Public Resource, Universal Library (CMU), volunteers, and institutional partners.
duplicates_mirrors: TEL-DLIB-002 | TEL-DLIB-003 | TEL-DLIB-004 | TEL-MSS-001 | TEL-PERIOD-001 | TEL-GOV-001
verification_method: IA advancedsearch counts per collection/mediatype; item metadata sampled for OCR and rights
unresolved_issues: Per-item copyright status cannot be resolved centrally; a PD-filter (by date/author death) is needed.
processing_needs: Filter out GOs and e-papers if needed; re-OCR with a better Telugu model; copyright screening; dedup across DLI/Universal Library mirrors.
quality_rationale: Directly verified; size measured or documented by source; licence stated by source.
telugu_content_check: Not applicable (not a Hugging Face dataset); see verification_method
